info.description: Hands-on lab step for a topic, matching TOPICS[].interactive in studio-vr's courseData.js (e.g. speaker-lab, equalizer-lab).

title.description: Optional heading shown above the activity — leave it blank to mount the activity with no heading at all (studio-vr treats a missing title the same way course.video-block/course.image-text-block treat their own optional heading fields: skip rendering it rather than showing an empty one). When set and this activity is a Section's interactive block (course.interactive-block, inside a Section's `blocks` zone), studio-vr already shows that Section's own `title` as a large lesson heading a couple of short paragraphs above this one — so this renders smaller, as a sub-heading for the activity, not a second page title. It only renders full-size when this activity is a Chapter's own standalone `interactive` field (a dedicated "Lab" step with no Section heading above it) — that's also the one place a blank title still shows up somewhere else: the course sidebar's nav label for that step falls back to "Untitled activity" rather than going blank. Keep this specific to the activity itself (e.g. "Harmonics: The Stack Above the Fundamental") rather than restating the Section title (e.g. "Harmonics") verbatim.

kind.description: Which lab component studio-vr should mount, e.g. "speaker-lab", "equalizer-lab", "compressor-lab", "daw-comping-lab", "sweet-spot-lab". Left as free text so new labs don't require a schema change.
